## What's new

- A port's page puts each fact on one line, wrapping when it is long, and starts the description below them, so the download size and the rest can no longer run into the description.
- What's New, and every other card that scrolls on its own, now keeps its text inside its window, fading in and out at the edges, and wraps it to the card's width.
- The notice at the top of the shelf and RomM's game details stay inside their boxes, however long.

---

ChaOS 2.1.1 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.1.1-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.1.1-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
